hook: Baumslag-Solitar groups act C^1 on an interval only when |m| equals |n|.
summary: The authors settle exactly when the group BS(m,n) can be realized by once-differentiable orientation-preserving maps of the interval: only when |n| = |m|. For slightly smoother maps (C^(1+alpha)) the list shrinks to a few trivial cases. This is a pure proof, and it covers integers m and n other than -1, 0 and 1.
title: Smooth actions of Baumslag-Solitar groups on the interval
